title: Create plan — golden path with all fields
steps: Assert page renders with 'Installment Plans' tab active
Assert Dialog opens with title 'Add Installment Plan'
Fill Description textarea with 'Pay over 6 months'
Assert new card 'Monthly (6 payments)' appears in grid
expected: New plan card visible in grid with code 'monthly_6', ×6 badge, Active badge, no Default badge

title: Create plan — set as default on creation
steps: Fill required Code and Name fields
Assert new card appears with amber 'Default' badge and star icon
expected: Plan card shows amber 'Default' badge. Previously-default plan (if any) loses the badge.

title: Edit plan — update name and premium
steps: Click 'Edit' on an existing active plan card
Assert Dialog opens with title 'Edit Installment Plan'
Assert 'Set as default plan' checkbox is NOT visible
Assert card now shows updated name
expected: Plan card updates in place with new name. Code unchanged.

title: Set default — promotes non-default active plan
steps: Ensure at least two active plans exist, one with 'Default' badge
Click 'Set default' button on a non-default active plan
Assert toast 'Default installment plan updated.' appears
Assert clicked plan now shows amber 'Default' badge
Assert former default plan no longer shows 'Default' badge
expected: Exactly one plan has the Default badge after mutation.

title: Disable plan — no services using it
steps: Click 'Disable' on an active plan that is not used by any active service
Assert NO red warning box appears
Assert plan card now shows red 'Inactive' badge (if 'All' filter active) or disappears (if 'Active' filter)
expected: Plan is deactivated. With default 'active' filter, card disappears from grid.

title: Disable plan — shows service-usage warning
steps: Ensure a plan with code 'monthly_6' is referenced by at least 1 active service's availablePaymentPlans
Assert red warning box appears with text matching 'This plan is enabled on N active service(s)...'
expected: Warning box shows correct service count. Deactivation proceeds regardless of warning.

title: Filter pills — switch between Active / Inactive / All
steps: Assert default filter is 'Active' (pill has dark background)
Assert grid shows only inactive plans (red 'Inactive' badges)
Assert grid shows only active plans
expected: Filter updates immediately (client-side). No network request on filter change.

title: Duplicate code rejection
steps: Note the code of an existing plan (e.g. 'full')
Enter the same code 'full' in the Code field
expected: Toast shows a raw Postgres error message (NOT a user-friendly BAD_REQUEST message — this is a gap: unique violation is not caught as BAD_REQUEST by the router). Dialog stays open.

title: Form validation — empty name
steps: Assert no API call is made
expected: Client-side guard fires toast. Form does not submit.

title: Form validation — numInstallments = 0
expected: Client-side guard fires toast. Browser min=1 HTML attribute also prevents submission on form submit if user uses arrow keys/stepper.

title: Form validation — numInstallments = NaN (empty field)
expected: parseInt('', 10) = NaN, triggering client guard.

title: Form validation — premium = 101
expected: Client-side guard catches p > 100. HTML max=100 also blocks native form submit (but not JS submit path since handleSubmit uses e.preventDefault).

title: Form validation — premium = -1
expected: Client-side guard catches p < 0.

title: Empty state — inactive filter with no inactive plans
steps: Ensure all plans are active (none inactive)
Assert EmptyState renders with description 'No inactive plans.'
Assert 'New Plan' action button is NOT shown in EmptyState
expected: EmptyState uses inactive-specific description. No create action offered.

title: Empty state — no plans exist (first-run)
steps: On a tenant with no installment plans configured
Assert EmptyState renders with title 'No installment plans'
Assert description includes 'No installment plans configured yet'
Assert 'New Plan' action button is shown in EmptyState
expected: EmptyState create action works as an alternate entry point for first plan.
selectorHints: getByText('No installment plans configured yet. Add one to get started.')

title: Error state — API fetch failure
steps: Simulate or wait for a network error on the installmentPlans.list query
Assert StatusCallout with variant 'error' renders with 'Failed to load installment plans'
expected: Error callout visible with retry. Grid and EmptyState are NOT shown (gated by !isError).

title: No organization guard — renders inline message
steps: Assert component renders inline message 'Select an organization to manage installment plans.'
expected: No API call, no loader, just the message div.
selectorHints: getByText('Select an organization to manage installment plans.')

title: Disable default plan — default badge removed silently
steps: Ensure a plan exists that has the amber 'Default' badge AND is active
Assert plan becomes inactive (or disappears from active filter)
Assert NO plan now has the 'Default' badge
Assert no error toast — service silently clears isDefault
expected: isDefault is silently cleared on deactivation. No UI warning about losing the default plan.

title: Edit dialog — code field is locked
steps: Assert Code input is disabled (cannot be typed in)
Assert helper text reads 'Cannot be changed after creation.'
Assert 'Set as default plan' checkbox is NOT rendered
expected: Code is immutable; isDefault not changeable via edit form.

title: Cancel deactivate dialog — state fully cleared
steps: Assert plan still shows as Active in grid
expected: deactivateTarget, deactivateWarning, deactivateDialogOpen all reset. No mutation fired.

title: Sample amount input — live preview updates
steps: Assert sample amount defaults to RM 1,200
Click the sample amount input and clear it, type '600'
Assert all plan cards update their sample math block to reflect RM 600 total
expected: Math preview in all cards updates in real time. Blur reformats the displayed value.

title: isMutating disables all action buttons
steps: Trigger any mutation (e.g. setDefault) and intercept before completion
Assert 'Edit', 'Disable', 'Set default' buttons on all cards are disabled
expected: All interactive card buttons and the New Plan button are disabled while any mutation is in-flight.

title: Tab switch resets filter to 'active'
steps: Click 'Services' tab in the outer tab bar
expected: Filter state is local useState — not persisted in URL. Tab unmount/remount resets to default 'active'. This is a regression from the old settings page which used route search params.

title: Permission guard — service_management:read required for tab access
steps: Log in as a user who does NOT have service_management:read permission
Assert redirect to /dashboard with unauthorized signal
expected: Route beforeLoad calls requirePermission('service_management:read'). Users without this permission are redirected. NOTE: old settings page required 'payments:update' — any user with payments:update but not service_management:read is now blocked.
